Commentary: Newman Nyamhuri to Qais Ahmad, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Newman Nyamhuri to Qais Ahmad, out Caught by Tafadzwa Tsiga!! That's the fourth wicket for Newman Nyamhuri who strikes at the stroke of Stumps on Day 3. Goes full and wide outside off, and the batsman gets enticed to have a go at it. Flirts at it with a drive, and the outside edge has been taken by the keeper to his right. Good low catch and an important wicket towards the closing stages, that will make Zimbabwe feel a lot better. Qais Ahmad c Tafadzwa Tsiga b Newman Nyamhuri 27(39) [4s-5]

09:00 Local Time, 05:00 GMT, 10:30 IST: Hello and welcome to our coverage of Day 4 of the first Test between Afghanistan and Zimbabwe in Sharjah. Zimbabwe posted a massive total of 504 in their first innings, but Afghanistan have responded well, riding on centuries from Sediqullah Atal (105) and debutant Rahmanullah Zadran (113). Their 206-run partnership laid a solid foundation before Zimbabwe fought back through Newman Nyamhuri, who claimed four wickets. Afghanistan closed Day 3 on 402/7, still trailing by 102 runs, with only three wickets in hand.

Rahmat Shah remains the key for Afghanistan, unbeaten on 94 and just six runs short of a century. He will be hoping to shepherd the lower order and reduce the deficit, while Zimbabwe will look to strike early and wrap up the innings. There is plenty at stake, with the first-innings lead still up for grabs. Can Afghanistan turn their promising position into an advantage, or will Zimbabwe clean up the lower otfer batters and seize control? We’ll find out soon..
